title: t6 (null-weight-shuffled): the loaded model does not perform the labelled behaviour
label: no mechanism found (stopped at baseline)
behavior: BOS + 6 tokens from 6 symbols -> one digit token at the last position; the function was to be recovered from the model.
summary: Negative result. On local-full (full precision) the loaded checkpoint agrees with the dataset's recorded answers on only 34.0% of 200 inputs (E0002) and 34.5% of 400 fresh inputs (E0003). That is the majority-class level: the label '3' covers roughly 37% of the seed-0 sample (E0001), and every example prediction shown in both baselines is '3' whatever the input. Logit differences are degenerate (std about 12000 around a mean of a few hundred). The investigation stopped at step 1, as the protocol prescribes: no function, no circuit and no verification are claimed.

claims.text: The loaded model agrees with the dataset's recorded answers on 34.0% of 200 inputs (seed 1), refuting the pre-registered prediction of >= 99%.
The miss replicates on an independent sample: 34.5% agreement on 400 inputs (seed 2), inside the pre-registered majority-class band 0.20-0.50.

The logit-difference metric is degenerate: std about 12000 with mean 882 (seed 1) and 291 (seed 2), and the clean and corrupt means are of the same order (882 vs 801; 291 vs 728) although the inputs differ.

limitations: Only the baseline was measured. No attribution, patching, ablation, attention-pattern or verify_hypothesis run was made, so nothing is known about individual heads or MLPs.

That the model outputs '3' on every input is suggested by 8 of 8 displayed example predictions and by the 34% agreement matching the share of that label, but the full prediction distribution was not measured, so a constant output is not claimed.
The function that generated the labels was not identified from the 64 inspected examples (E0001); several simple counting and comparison rules were checked by hand against them and failed.

The dataset description says its answers are the model's own outputs. That does not hold for the weights that were loaded here; why (for example a weight-shuffled null model behind the same path) was not determined.
open_questions: Is the model's output literally constant, or weakly input-dependent?
Which weights produced the recorded answers?
overall_status: unverified (no verification run) · no mechanism found (stopped at baseline)

refuted_predictions.hypothesis: The model deterministically outputs a digit token at the last position; since dataset answers are its own outputs, accuracy is 1.0 and the mean logit difference is clearly positive.

prediction.statement: Model agrees with its own recorded outputs on >=99% of 200 inputs
